COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

Straightforward, practical information about invisible grill installation, balcony safety, and building society approvals.

What exactly are invisible grills, and how do they work? +
Invisible grills are durable safety systems manufactured from stainless steel wire cables (typically 2.0mm or 2.5mm thick) encased in a transparent protective polymer sheath. The cables are anchored under tension into structural aluminium track frames along the perimeter of balconies or windows, spaced 50mm or 75mm apart. They provide reliable fall protection while preserving panoramic outdoor views.
Are invisible grills strong enough to prevent a child or adult from falling? +
Yes. Each individual stainless steel wire is engineered for durable strength. When properly tensioned and anchored into reinforced perimeter slabs with expansion fasteners, the tensioned cable array forms an effective barrier against accidental falls.
How do invisible grills compare with traditional iron or steel grills? +
Traditional MS or cast-iron grills are heavy, block natural light, obscure outdoor views, and require periodic repainting against rust. In contrast, invisible grills preserve panoramic views, use corrosion-resistant stainless steel cables, allow unrestricted airflow, comply with high-rise society elevation rules, and can be cut by rescue personnel with dedicated wire cutters during a fire emergency.
Can invisible grills be cut easily by burglars or intruders? +
Invisible grills are designed primarily as architectural fall-protection for high-rise balconies and windows (typically 3rd floor and above). While they cannot be cut with domestic scissors or kitchen knives, in a fire emergency rescue personnel can sever individual wires using wire cutters.
What is the difference between 50mm and 75mm wire spacing? +
50mm (approx. 2 inches) is our recommended child and pet safety standard, helping prevent small hands, toddler heads, and toys from slipping through. 75mm (approx. 3 inches) provides maximum visual transparency and is popular for expansive view balconies.
Will the wires rust or discolour over time? +
Our invisible grills use stainless steel cables encased in a protective coating designed for outdoor residential balconies and weathering resistance. The outer casing additionally shields the stainless steel core against airborne dust and moisture.
